title: Classification of squared normal operators on unitary and Euclidean spaces
abstract: We give a canonical form for a complex matrix, whose square is normal, under transformations of unitary similarity as well as a canonical form for a real matrix, whose square is normal, under transformations of orthogonal similarity.
